high_level_description: The image is a news article headline with a photograph of Arun Goel, who has quit as an election commissioner. The headline reads: "With Lok Sabha polls looming, Arun Goel quits as election commissioner." Below the headline, there is additional text by Bharti Jain from TNN, updated on March 10, 2024, at 03:50 IST. The photograph shows Arun Goel sitting at a desk in what appears to be an official office setting. He is wearing a dark blue kurta and is writing or signing something on a document placed on the desk in front of him
